attributes.name: Staff of Empty Souls
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card and recharge a spell to use your Arcane or Divine skill plus a number of d4s equal to the bane's adventure deck number; this counts as playing a spell. If the bane has the Undead trait, when you assemble your dice, replace the d4s with d8s.

When you defeat a bane that has the Undead trait, reveal this card to recharge a random card from your discard pile. You may do this even if you played this card on the check.
attributes.traits: Staff, Attack, Undead, Magic, Arcane, Divine, Veteran
